questions.answer: There is approx. 80% of student from asia - most of whom are unable to speak english. It can be very difficult to communicate

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. lots of asians who do not speak english. Avoid courses, especially mgmt courses where you have to work in groups
2. have a big bag of money with you
3. travel
